entities.name: Milada Emmerová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milada Emmerová is a Czech doctor, politician and former Minister of Health for the Czech Republic. As of April 2023, she is a member of the Czech Social Democratic Party (ČSSD). Currently she is senator of Senate of the Parliament of the Czech Republic.
